videos.headline: Will Shipley follows his blocks for Clemson's first TD
videos.description: Clemson gets on the board first as Will Shipley follows his blockers into the end zone for the short touchdown run.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Will Shipley follows his blocks for Clemson's first TD) 2022/10/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Sean Tucker runs wheel route for a Syracuse TD
videos.description: Syracuse evens up the score as Sean Tucker runs the wheel route for a 12-yard touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Sean Tucker runs wheel route for a Syracuse TD) 2022/10/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Syracuse's Carter drags the feet for impressive INT
videos.description: Syracuse gets the turnover as Ja'Had Carter keeps his feet in for the interception.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Syracuse's Carter drags the feet for impressive INT) 2022/10/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Syracuse goes 90 yards on the scoop-and-score TD
videos.description: DJ Uiagalelei fumbles the ball and it's picked up by Syracuse's Ja'Had Carter for the 90-yard scoop-and-score.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Syracuse goes 90 yards on the scoop-and-score TD) 2022/10/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Shrader dives towards the pylon for a Syracuse TD
videos.description: Garrett Shrader breaks free from the rush and lunges for the pylon for a 7-yard Syracuse touchdown.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Shrader dives towards the pylon for a Syracuse TD) 2022/10/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Shipley gives the ball back to Syracuse with a fumble
videos.description: Will Shipley gets the ball ripped loose for a fumble, giving Syracuse the ball back.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Shipley gives the ball back to Syracuse with a fumble) 2022/10/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Syracuse forces 4th Clemson turnover with an INT
videos.description: Jason Simmons Jr. picks off DJ Uiagalelei, forcing Clemson's fourth turnover of the game.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Syracuse forces 4th Clemson turnover with an INT) 2022/10/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Mafah's 4th-down TD pulls Clemson closer
videos.description: Phil Mafah scores the short touchdown on fourth down, pulling Clemson within one possession in the fourth quarter.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Mafah's 4th-down TD pulls Clemson closer) 2022/10/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Clemson draws huge PI penalty late in 4th
videos.description: Syracuse looks like they have the stop but a pass interference penalty on Isaiah Johnson gives Clemson the first down late in the fourth quarter.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Clemson draws huge PI penalty late in 4th) 2022/10/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Clemson seals victory with an INT
videos.description: Clemson's R.J. Mickens picks off Garrett Shrader in the final minute, clinching the win for Clemson.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Clemson seals victory with an INT) 2022/10/22 ESHEET

videos.headline: Clemson overcomes 4 turnovers to rally past Syracuse
videos.description: Clemson switches quarterbacks in the second half and overcomes four turnovers to beat Syracuse 24-21.
